canonical_project: Altenholz green data center proposal (Gdd GmbH)
notes: Kieler Nachrichten (2026-05-21) reports Gdd GmbH presented plans in the Altenholz building committee for a green data center powered partly by the Altenholz/Felm wind project; follow-up local reporting links a proposed ~53 ha, ~60 MW solar park as another possible power source; NDR (2026-01-30) covers a residents' referendum against the related wind park. Early-stage local proposal; status planned, capacity not disclosed.
